units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 12:1">Ḥull. XII, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>שילוח הקן</he> the duty of letting the mother bird go when a nest is taken out (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 22:6">Deut. XXII, 6</cite> sq.).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> <he>אש יוצאה מקִינּוֹ</he> fire goes forth from its nest and burns it (the phœnix, v. <cite ref="H00324"><he>חוֹל</he> II</cite>); Midr. Sam. ch. XII; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 917:5">Yalk. Job 917</cite> <he>מקִנּוֹ</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20:6">Ex. R. s. 20</cite> <he>מצאו להם קן</he> they (the Israelites) found a nest for themselves (with ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 84:4">Ps. LXXXIV, 4</cite>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (fem.) the couple of sacrificial birds (Lev. XII, 8; XIV, 30; a. e.).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kinnim 2:1">Ḳinnim II, 1</cite> <he>קן סתומה</he> a couple of birds concerning which it has not yet been decided which is to be the burnt offering, and which the sin offering; <cite ref="Mishnah Kinnim 2:4">ib. 4</cite> <he>קן מפורשת</he> which has been decided upon; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קִנִּים</he>, <cite ref="S01587"><he>קִנִּין</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00089"><he>קִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Keritot 28a">Ker. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>אין הק׳ מתפרשות וכ׳</he> the special designation of the couples is made either by the owner or by the priest’s action.

Ned. IV, 3 קִינֵּי זבין the bird sacrifices of those cured from gonorrhœa; ק׳ יולדות those of women after confinement; a. fr.—Ḳinnim, Ḳinnin, name of a treatise of the Mishnah, of the Order of Ḳodashim.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:9">Lev. R. s. 14</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00565"><he>כִּינָּה</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="K00308"><he>כּוֹנָנִית</he></cite>.

R. to I, 9</cite> <he>שלא נבראו בי ק׳ וכ׳</he> because no chambers (for the reception of prophecy) were created within me until now &c.; (<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 28:6">Ex.
